hero.headline: Perfection in Every Panel.
hero.title: Your car looking like new again
hero.subtitle: Expert paint damage repair — from small chips to deep scratches. Precision work with guaranteed results.

servicesOverview.title: Craftsmanship at Every Level
servicesOverview.subtitle: From minor damage to full restoration — we take care of it.

one.title: Chip & Scratch Repair
one.description: Every scratch or chip is repaired layer by layer with precisely matched paint. Our technicians work with professional colour-mixing systems for an invisible result.
one.detail: Suitable for stone chips, parking dents and surface scratches.

two.title: Dent Removal (PDR)
two.description: Paintless Dent Repair — the gentlest method to remove dents without affecting the original paint. No spraying, no sanding.
two.detail: Ideal for hail damage, parking dents and minor collisions.

three.title: Colour Matching & Spraying
three.description: When a panel needs a full respray, we ensure a perfect colour match with your vehicle's original factory colour.
three.detail: Including primer coat, colour coat and clear lacquer coat.

beforeAfter.heading: The Results Speak for Themselves
beforeAfter.subline: See the transformation — from damaged paint to showroom quality.

about.storyText: Colour King has been the trusted name in Rotterdam for damage repair and paint work for over 15 years. What started as a small family business has grown into a modern auto body shop with a team of experienced craftsmen. We combine traditional craftsmanship with modern techniques to restore every car to its best condition.
